intent: Review all database docs and DB tasks against the real local Postgres (apply M1-M9 SQL, audit RLS and grants, test RBAC claims) and apply the approved wording fixes only (option A).
summary: Operator asked for a review of the docs and tasks because they describe the database. Method: applied every sql block of docs/database-architecture/m1..m9 in order to the running local Postgres 17 inside one transaction that always rolled back (0 tables left), with a savepoint per block; then audited the catalog (RLS, policies, grants, triggers, cron), ran behaviour tests and a names cross-check. Results: all 12 migration blocks apply (M1 usage examples 5-7 skipped); RBAC promises hold (group inheritance, suspension, escalation blocked, last-admin guard, hook returns 15 permissions); every name used in the docs exists; definer functions set search_path; agent views are security_invoker. Findings: HIGH M9 as written creates six tables with no RLS and anon could read and delete candidates; MEDIUM helper and trigger functions of M3-M6 are executable by PUBLIC/anon; MEDIUM M6 has no SQL for upsert_google_event and prune_google_events; MEDIUM PSI-008 accept wrongly required roles and groups in the seed (M1 inserts admin, all-members and the 15 permissions itself); LOW 27 unindexed foreign keys, cron count note, user_invites.email is intentional. The operator approved option A only: accept lines of PSI-008, 012, 015, 030, 080 and the seed.sql comment were corrected, and a warning was added to m9-talent.md (not an RLS change). Findings B, C, D were NOT applied and are follow-ups. Outcome stays partial: the PSI-008 wording was changed by an agent, so a human confirms it. Tooling is saved in scripts/db-review/. Supersedes the earlier PSI-008 entry.

verification.manual: Applied 12 migration blocks (M1 blocks 1-4, M2-M9) in one transaction: 0 failures, rolled back, 0 public tables left. Audit and behaviour SQL ran in the same way. Behaviour results: profiles and all-members created by trigger for 4 new users; admin has roles.manage true, plain member false; role via group true then false after removal; suspended member false; users.manage-only holder blocked (42501) from granting admin and from adding someone to a group whose role it cannot grant, allowed to grant a role it fully holds; last admin removal blocked (P0001 'At least one active user must keep roles.manage'), allowed when a second admin exists; supabase_auth_admin can execute the hook; hook returned 15 permissions, roles [admin], groups [all-members]. Anon probes: candidates and skills readable (1 row each), anon DELETE on candidates removed 1 row, roles and profiles not readable, anon can execute can_see_event but not has_permission. db reset was not re-run: seed.sql changed only in a comment. Not tested: calendar, kanban, Drive-root and agent-view visibility logic, and the M1 usage-example blocks.
